title: OpenProposal schema release manifest
description: One lock's release manifest, `release.json` at the root of its schema tree: each file's path with its version and its JCS SHA-256 digest, the digests of the tree and of the model, and the changes since the last frozen release. `npm run release` writes it from the model; `releases/<lock>/<version>/` keeps a frozen copy with its model, its rules, its conformance corpus, and its schema tree.

lock.description: The name of the spec lock the tree is built from, such as `main`.

release.description: The release version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, as Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 writes it, with no pre-release or build part. The major is the one in every path and `$id`.

previous.description: The last frozen release this one is compared with, or null for the first release.

input.description: The pinned specification the model is resolved from.

model.description: The JCS SHA-256 digest of the model the files are emitted from.

rules.description: The JCS SHA-256 digest of the lock's rules, `rules.json`.

digest.description: The JCS SHA-256 digest of `{ <path>: <schema> }` over every file of the tree.

files.description: Every file of the tree, by its path relative to this manifest.

version.description: The release in which the file last changed.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of the file's schema.

changes.description: The differences between the previous release and this one, in the model, the rules, and the schema files, sorted by type, member, change, and detail.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, the core of a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version.

digest.description: 64 lowercase hex characters, as the kernel's `Digest` writes a SHA-256.

class.description: `breaking` where a payload or a change valid under the previous release may be invalid under this one; `additive` where what a payload must satisfy changes otherwise: this one accepts or defines more, or a rule changes in a way its vectors don't show to reject more; `annotation` where only prose or citations changed.

type.description: The named type, the rule's owner, or the schema file's path.

member.description: The property, term, union branch, profile field or path, rule, or `$defs` entry the change is about.
